title: RESIDE known-overlap-quarantined continuous-utility measurement
rationale: The Haze4K continuous-utility precision pilot validly blocked its 100-scene population because the conservative planning SD 0.444219 dB implied about 1,213 independent scenes for the unchanged 0.025 dB precision distance. It did not test the mean or reject the continuous target. Independently archived quarantine routes now authorize design on 8,813 ITS and 8,006 OTS clear scenes after removal of verified Haze4K exposure. This orthogonal target-domain route preserves the original two-action continuous PSNR utility contrasts, taper, 0.05 dB gate, 0.025 dB precision distance, official checkpoint, no-training rule and original-clear-scene unit. It reports ITS and OTS separately and uses their maximum mean as the primary estimand; no sample-size pooling treats indoor and outdoor scenes as exchangeable. To cover both simultaneous stratum claims at familywise 95 percent, a Bonferroni critical value 2.241403 with the archived planning SD requires 1,587 independent scenes per stratum. Four haze variants per scene are deterministic nested repeats and never increase n. The failed ITS q-region construct is excluded rather than repaired or reinterpreted.

orthogonal_changes.reason: Use large previously unused RESIDE ITS and OTS synthetic-scene populations after archived verified-overlap quarantine, while preserving the frozen Haze4K continuous-utility target and gates.
Require separate indoor ITS and outdoor OTS estimates with simultaneous familywise uncertainty instead of treating cross-domain scenes as exchangeable.

scientific_contract.question: On separately reported RESIDE ITS indoor and OTS outdoor known-overlap-quarantined synthetic-scene populations, is the frozen Haze4K ConvIR-B continuous-utility contrast error below 0.05 dB in both strata with simultaneous 95 percent precision distance no larger than 0.025 dB?

intervention.primary_variable: maximum of separate ITS and OTS scene-mean worst-held-out-phase area-weighted L-infinity errors between source-taper-projected and held-out two-dimensional keep-referenced PSNR utility contrasts
intervention.reference: the unchanged 0.05 dB continuous-utility error margin with simultaneous 95 percent stratum intervals and 0.025 dB maximum mean-to-bound distance
intervention.matched_budget: 1,587 salted-hash-selected eligible original clear scenes per stratum, four salted-hash-selected nested official haze variants per scene, one official inference per variant, and no result-adaptive extension
fixed_factors: ITS uses only the 8,813-scene complement of the archived TRAIN_AND_SELECTION_EXPOSURE 2,187-ID exclusion asset
OTS uses only the 8,006-scene complement of the archived final 964-ID targeted-geometry exclusion asset
both populations are described as known-overlap-quarantined and never fully source-disjoint
ITS and OTS are separate primary strata and are never sample-size-pooled as exchangeable observations
the primary estimand is the maximum of the two separately estimated stratum means, so both strata must pass
scene selection and within-scene four-variant selection use only public salted SHA-256 order over IDs and filenames before any image decoding or outcome
the original clear scene is the only independent analysis unit; haze variants, phases, tiles, pixels, actions and bootstrap draws are nested repeats
actions remain clip(hazy + scale times (official_prediction minus hazy), 0, 1) at keep 1.0, weaken 0.8 and strengthen 1.2
for each tile and non-keep action utility remains 10 log10(MSE_keep divided by MSE_action); keep is exactly zero
grid origins remain (0,0), (0,16), (16,0) and (16,16), with 32-pixel tiles and the verified strictly-positive normalized raised-cosine taper
each phase is held out once; only the other three phases contribute to its projected utility
within phase the two-action absolute contrast error uses L-infinity, tiles use pixel-area weights, four haze variants are equally averaged and the worst of four phases is the scene value

content preprocessing preserves aspect ratio, caps the long edge at 320 pixels without upscaling, reflect-extends the model canvas only to at least 256 pixels and a multiple of 32, and crops predictions before every estimand

each stratum interval is the conservative envelope of a normal simultaneous interval with Bonferroni critical value 2.241402727604947 and a 20,000-resample scene bootstrap 98.75 percent two-sided interval
the original 0.05 dB margin and 0.025 dB precision target never change
the archived Haze4K scenes are not included and do not increase the new independent n
the failed ITS q-region construct, transmission-based local regions and its 0.99 recovery gate are not used

the protected-data-free device-aware contract strictly loads the exact official checkpoint, executes the formal 12,696-inference iteration count on a fixed 256x320 synthetic fixture, checks a frozen 840-second wall bound and 8,192-MiB peak-CUDA-memory class, and traverses exact continuous utility, interval and terminal finalizer paths

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: A cross-domain disagreement may reflect genuine indoor-versus-outdoor synthetic population heterogeneity, the fixed worst-phase aggregation, or the L-infinity action aggregation. Separate simultaneous estimates distinguish that from the false precision obtained by pooling nested variants or treating ITS and OTS scenes as one exchangeable population, but they do not establish real-haze transport or complete source disjointness.

precision_contract.rationale: For two simultaneously reported strata, Bonferroni familywise 95 percent uses z=2.241402727604947. With archived conservative planning SD 0.444218872067388 dB and unchanged target distance 0.025 dB, ceil((z*SD/distance)^2)=1,587 independent original clear scenes per stratum. ITS has 8,813 and OTS 8,006 eligible scenes after exact archived quarantine, so both capacities pass without counting nested variants.

capability.production_path_statement: The exact official Haze4K ConvIR-B graph strictly loads the official checkpoint and executes a protected-data-free same-asymptotic-scale probe of exactly 12,696 finite batch-one 256x320 CUDA forwards through the shared inference path. The contract freezes and checks at most 12,696 iterations, 840 wall seconds and 8,192 MiB peak allocated CUDA memory, then exercises the exact frozen continuous-utility taper projection, simultaneous interval and precision-first typed terminal finalizer. Formal runtime remains 12,698 total units, 14,400 expected wall seconds and 43,200 timeout seconds; no scientific data or training is permitted.

precision.estimand: route-wide count of independent original-clear-scene groups under a fixed 1,587-ITS plus 1,587-OTS allocation; the scientific contract separately freezes the stricter per-stratum simultaneous design
precision.source_reference: The archived pilot planning SD is 0.444218872067388 dB. The schema base calculation is 1,213 groups. The route analyzes 3,174 independent scenes under a fixed nonpoolable allocation of 1,587 ITS and 1,587 OTS. The scientific contract adds the stricter Bonferroni requirement of 1,587 per stratum without changing the 0.025 dB target; the eligible capacities are 8,813 ITS and 8,006 OTS.
